close_reason: Completed: src/memory/seed.rs migrated. All 16 import_email and 5 create_object call sites now pass &() as caller parameter. cargo check -p jmap-mail-server --all-targets compiles clean.
description:
src/memory/seed.rs has 34 errors after the MailBackend CallerCtx migration:

  16 × E0061: 6-arg method takes 5 args (import_email calls)
   5 × E0061: 4-arg method takes 3 args (create_object calls)
  13 × E0308: mismatched types (cascade)

All call sites in seed.rs (lines 218, 236, 254, 273, 292, 314-810) call MailBackend methods directly:
  .create_object(account_id, create_id, obj)        # missing &() first arg
  .import_email(account_id, blob_id, mailbox_ids, keywords, received_at)   # missing &() first arg

The fix is mechanical: prepend &() to every call to a MailBackend or JmapBackend method.

This blocks 'cargo check -p jmap-mail-server --tests' (and therefore the test suite). Tests are otherwise migrated and the test side has zero errors.

Suggested fix: apply /tmp/fix_method_calls.py to crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory/seed.rs — same script used for the tests sweep on JMAP-z4cz.
title: mail-server: migrate src/memory/seed.rs to new CallerCtx convention
